roles_about.owner: Every permission; only Owners appoint Owners and change the company details.
roles_about.admin: Every permission except the Owner tasks.
roles_about.moderator: Review reports, photos and appeals, hide content, suspend accounts.
roles_about.support: Answer tickets, see contact details, send password links, view as a member.
roles_about.content_editor: Maintain and publish content, brand and the vehicle catalogue.
roles_about.analyst: See statistics; read members, vehicles and reports only.

index.title: Team
index.intro: Who works in the admin and with which roles. You invite new team members by e‑mail; they then set up two-factor sign-in.
index.caption: Team members with roles, status and last sign-in
index.empty_body: Change the filters or invite a new team member.
index.error: The team could not be loaded

invite.title: Invite a team member
invite.body: The person gets a link that works for 72 hours and only once. They set their password and then set up two-factor sign-in.
invite.name: Name
invite.roles_hint: You can only give roles whose permissions you hold yourself.
invite.owner_only: Only an Owner can invite an Owner.
invite.elevating: Admin, Owner and roles with sensitive permissions apply only after an approval. Until then the account has only the other roles.
invite.reason_hint: Required for the approval. Goes into the audit log, 10 to 1,000 characters.

errors.name: Enter a name of 2 to 120 characters.
errors.reason: The approval needs a reason of 10 to 1,000 characters.

invite.accepted: Your password is set. Sign in now and set up two-factor sign-in.

accept.title: Accept the invitation
accept.intro: Set your password for the SPEED CLUB admin. Then sign in and set up two-factor sign-in.
accept.password_hint: At least :min characters. A long sentence is safer than a short word.
accept.link_broken: This link is incomplete. Please open it straight from the e‑mail.

show.error: The team member could not be loaded
show.no_roles: No role: the account sees only “My account”.
show.all_atoms: Owner and Admin always hold every permission.
show.two_factor_off: Not set up yet. The account gets into the admin only after setting it up.
show.own_account: This is your account. You manage your sessions and two-factor in “My account”; you cannot raise your own roles.
show.view_only: You can view this team member but not change it.
show.owner_view_only: Only an Owner changes an Owner account.

roles_drawer.title: Roles of :name
roles_drawer.body: The new roles apply at once, except for Admin, Owner, sensitive permissions or an Owner account: then an approval is requested.
roles_drawer.four_eyes: This change needs an approval by a second person:

why.elevates: It grants Admin, Owner or a sensitive permission.
why.owner: It concerns an Owner account; a second Owner approves.
why.demotes: It takes the Admin role away.

roles_drawer.reason_optional: Optional, goes into the audit log.
roles_drawer.self: On your own account you can only give roles up, not add them.

deactivate.title: Deactivate :name
deactivate.body: Every session ends at once, open invitation links and started view-as sessions too. Roles stay, so a reactivation restores the account.
deactivate.four_eyes: Owners and Admins are deactivated only after an approval.

reactivate.title: Reactivate :name
reactivate.body: The account gets access back with its roles, password and two-factor sign-in.

delete.title: Delete :name
delete.body: Name, e‑mail address, password, two-factor and roles are removed. The audit log then names the account “Deleted team member”. This cannot be undone.
delete.needs_deactivation: Deactivate the account before you delete it.

revoke_sessions.title: End all sessions of :name
revoke_sessions.body: Every sign-in of the account ends at once; to go on working it signs in again.

reset_two_factor.title: Reset two-factor of :name
reset_two_factor.body: For a lost authenticator app. After a second Owner approves, every session ends; the account sets a new password through “Forgot password” and sets up two-factor sign-in again.

resend.title: Resend the invitation to :name
resend.body: A new link replaces the old one and again works for 72 hours.

roles_page.title: Roles
roles_page.intro: Roles bundle permissions. The six base roles stay; you add your own roles with a description. Sensitive permissions apply only after an approval.
roles_page.caption: Roles with permissions and team members
roles_page.error: The roles could not be loaded
roles_page.empty_custom: No custom role yet. Add one when a task does not fit a base role.
roles_page.in_use: Still assigned: take the role away from every team member first.

role_form.name: Name
role_form.name_hint: 3 to 60 characters. Base roles keep their name.
role_form.description_hint: What the role is for, up to 500 characters.
role_form.atoms_count: {0} No permission chosen|{1} 1 permission chosen|[2,*] :count permissions chosen
role_form.sensitive: Sensitive permissions (with the four-eyes symbol) apply only after an approval by a second person.
role_form.reason_hint: Required as soon as a sensitive permission is added. 10 to 1,000 characters.

errors.name: Enter a name of 3 to 60 characters (letters, digits, spaces, dot, hyphen).
errors.reason: The approval needs a reason of 10 to 1,000 characters.

role_delete.title: Delete role :name
role_delete.body: The role disappears from the permission matrix. This cannot be undone.

matrix.title: Permission matrix
matrix.intro: Which role holds which permissions. Before saving you see what changes and how many people it affects. Owner and Admin always hold every permission.
matrix.caption: Permissions per role
matrix.error: The permission matrix could not be loaded
matrix.sensitive: Sensitive permission: granted only after an approval
matrix.view_only: You can view the matrix; only team members with “Manage roles and permissions” can change it.
matrix.diff_body: This is how the matrix changes. Removed and non-sensitive permissions apply at once.
matrix.diff_four_eyes: Sensitive permissions are added (:atoms). The whole change applies only after an approval by a second person who holds none of the roles.
matrix.diff_total: {0} Affects nobody|{1} Affects 1 person|[2,*] Affects :count people
matrix.diff_failed: The changes could not be checked.
matrix.reason_optional: Optional, goes into the audit log.
